name: Restaurant Pizzeria Papalina
kurzbeschreibung:
**Restaurant Pizzeria Papalina in Nassereith**

Discover authentic Italian flavors in the heart of the **Tirol** Alps! At **Pizzeria Papalina** in **Nassereith**, just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, you’ll enjoy freshly baked pizzas with regional ingredients, handmade pasta, and a cozy atmosphere. Whether you crave a classic **Margherita**, a hearty **Diavola**, or a seasonal special, every bite is crafted with passion. Pair your meal with a glass of fine Italian wine or a cold **Radler**—perfect for unwinding after a day of hiking or exploring the stunning **Ötztal** region. Don’t miss their famous **Tiramisu** for dessert! Family-friendly and welcoming, **Papalina** is your go-to spot for a taste of Italy in the mountains. Open daily—come for the food, stay for the warmth!
